cohort: A cohort of 3519 very-low-birth-weight (BW < 1500 g) infants born in Taiwan between 2016 and 2018, registered in the Taiwan Neonatal Network.
finding: Machine learning techniques can improve the accuracy of prediction models for prolonged in-hospital length of stay among very-low-birth-weight infants, with logistic regression and random forest showing better performance for prolonged LOS prediction.
gest_age: Includes various gestational age groups among VLBW infants
